method: Source-only variants compiled with the unchanged GC/1.3 Ninja target. Formatted instruction strings are copied verbatim from each raw objdiff and deduplicated by SHA-256; full raw reports are retained for baseline, best exact-frame variant, and final canonical/strict verification. Original raw-report hashes and build outputs are recorded. No emitted object was patched.
selected: three-order-210, with scratch variables renamed blue_bits/green_bits/red_bits and comments only

variant_families.baseline: Accepted-base source, identical to preserved attempt 4.
variant_families.aliases/register-aliases/rgb-scope: Local aliases for four parameters (with and without register); RGB unions restricted to a block.
variant_families.order-*: Permute group_index/group/work_group/result/i declarations, after parameter aliases.
variant_families.inline-*: Static inline C unsigned/signed conversion helpers; each initially owns an automatic DoubleBits union. All helpers inline; only fn_801F15D0 is emitted.
variant_families.inline-order-*: Move group_index/group and the named permutation of work_group/i/result after scale declarations.
variant_families.*field*: Replace item padding with Vec3 at offset 0x14; express call arguments as &item->direction instead of a byte-pointer cast. Item size remains 0x38.
variant_families.scratch-one/kind/stage/three: Pointer-taking inline helpers: one union for all calls; one per signedness; one per RGB/distance/limit/final-component stage; or three unions assigned to calls as 0120111012, respectively.
variant_families.combined*: Typed item member plus declaration order group_index/group/result/i/work_group. low variants store the low word before high word. limit-reuse uses one union for all signed limits and separate inlined automatic unions for unsigned conversions.
variant_families.slots-*: Two explicit unions. The 10-digit suffix gives the scratch index for initial RGB (3), distance (1), limits (3), final RGB (3), in order. Low word stored first. Declarations follow first-use order.
variant_families.three-order-*: Three explicit unions assigned 0120111012; suffix permutes declaration order. at-call adds six named s32 coordinate conversions before the distance call; before-item moves the point coordinate conversions before item selection. Neither changes generated instructions for a given declaration order.

exact_frame_reproduction_from_selected: Replace the three union declarations (blue_bits, green_bits, red_bits) with two unions declared in order red_bits then green_bits. Keep both pointer-taking inline helpers, low-word-first assignments, typed item member, and all scalar declaration order unchanged.
Initial RGB conversions use red_bits, green_bits, red_bits; distance uses red_bits; all three limits use green_bits; final RGB conversions use red_bits, red_bits, green_bits.

This is slot assignment 0100111001, with scratch0 renamed red_bits and scratch1 renamed green_bits. It measures 87.2018%, 940 bytes, and a 208-byte frame. It retains the helper calls and double-subtract/round pairs.

The three-union selected form ties the best measured score at 88.06278% while reducing the best earlier form from a 256-byte frame to 224 bytes. The 208-byte variant is retained as raw comparison evidence, not a second source translation unit.
